description: This Java class provides utility methods for URI encoding and decoding based on RFC 3986 and MIME formats. It supports encoding path segments, paths, query strings, and query parameters, as well as decoding encoded URIs.

classes.name: UriEncoding
classes.description: Final utility class for URI encoding and decoding, supporting RFC 3986 and form URL encoding formats.

methods.name: encodePath
methods.description: Encodes the given path according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodePathSegment
methods.description: Encodes the given path segment according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodeQuery
methods.description: Encodes the given query string according to the specified encoding type.

methods.name: encodeQueryParam
methods.description: Encodes a query parameter based on the encoding type.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes an encoded URI string based on the encoding type.
